chill.title: Yeouido Yunjungno Cherry Blossom Road Walk
chill.description: Walk beneath a mile-long tunnel of blooming cherry trees lining the Han River's banks.
chill.bonus: Catch a falling cherry blossom petal in your hand before it hits the ground.

chill.title: Sheep Cafe at Thanks Nature Cafe, Hongdae
chill.description: Order a milkshake and pet two live sheep wandering the floor of Seoul's original animal cafe.
chill.bonus: Feed the resident sheep and give it a name before you leave.

chill.title: Leeum Museum of Art
chill.description: Move between a Mario Botta concrete tower and a Jean Nouvel glass box packed with centuries of Korean and contemporary art.
chill.bonus: Pick the one artwork you'd steal if you could, and defend your choice to a friend.

chill.title: Deoksugung Stonewall Walkway & Royal Guard Ceremony
chill.description: Walk a tree-lined stone wall beside the palace, then catch guards in traditional dress marching through the gate.
chill.bonus: Time your visit to the Royal Guard-Changing Ceremony and march a few steps behind them.

chill.title: Daelim Changgo Warehouse Cafe, Seongsu
chill.description: Sip coffee under soaring ceilings inside a converted 1970s rice warehouse turned art gallery.
chill.bonus: Find the best natural-light photo spot in the old warehouse and take one candid shot.

chill.title: Banpo Hangang Park Rainbow Fountain Picnic
chill.description: Watch 200 nozzles shoot colored water off Banpo Bridge while takeout chicken cools on your picnic mat.
chill.bonus: Order fried chicken delivery straight to your picnic mat, Han River style.

chill.title: Changdeokgung Secret Garden Guided Tour
chill.description: Follow a guide through a walled royal garden of ancient trees and lotus ponds closed to unguided visitors.
chill.bonus: Spot the 300-year-old pavilion pond and guess which king sat there.

chill.title: Insadong Ssamziegil Craft Shopping & Tea
chill.description: Spiral up a courtyard of independent craft shops selling hand-carved stamps, pottery, and hanji paper goods.
chill.bonus: Buy a handmade souvenir from an artist actually working at their own stall.

chill.title: Some Sevit Floating Islands Sunset Walk, Yeouido
chill.description: Watch LED lights ripple across three man-made islands floating on the Han River at dusk.
chill.bonus: Watch the LED lights switch on over the water and time exactly when it happens.

chill.title: Seoul Forest Park Picnic & Deer Park
chill.description: Spread a blanket under plane trees and watch spotted deer roam free just steps from the city grid.
chill.bonus: Get within camera distance of the free-roaming deer without startling them.

chill.title: Spa Lei Jjimjilbang, Sinsa
chill.description: Soak in a jade-green rooftop bath, then steam it out in a wormwood sauna at Gangnam's favorite spa.
chill.bonus: Try the wormwood steam room and last a full 10 minutes.

adventure.title: N Seoul Tower & Namsan Cable Car
adventure.description: Glide up Namsan Mountain by cable car and watch the whole city light up from Seoul's most iconic tower.
adventure.bonus: Find a padlock wall and read three strangers' love notes out loud to your friend.

adventure.title: Jogyesa Temple Visit
adventure.description: Duck beneath centuries-old ginkgo trees into Seoul's main Buddhist temple, lanterns swaying overhead.
adventure.bonus: Light an incense stick and make a wish you'll actually tell someone about.

adventure.title: DMZ Third Tunnel & Dora Observatory Tour
adventure.description: Peer through binoculars into North Korea from the Dora Observatory after crawling through an invasion tunnel dug beneath the DMZ.
adventure.bonus: Snap a photo at the Bridge of Freedom without smiling once the whole time.

adventure.title: Hanyangdoseong Inwangsan Wall Hike
adventure.description: Trace centuries-old fortress walls over granite boulders with skyline views stretching from Bukhansan to downtown.
adventure.bonus: Find the spot where the city wall meets exposed granite boulders and take a panorama.

adventure.title: Sunrise Yoga on the Lawn, Ichon Hangang Park
adventure.description: Flow through a sunrise vinyasa session on open grass as river fog lifts off the Han.
adventure.bonus: Hold the final pose an extra ten seconds while watching the river traffic.

adventure.title: Lotte World Adventure & Magic Island
adventure.description: Bounce between an indoor ice rink, a lakeside outdoor park, and a French Renaissance-style castle without ever leaving Jamsil.
adventure.bonus: Take a selfie with a Lotte World mascot out on Magic Island.

adventure.title: War Memorial of Korea Immersive Exhibit
adventure.description: Climb into a real fighter jet cockpit and walk beneath tanks and warplanes inside one of Asia's largest war museums.
adventure.bonus: Sit inside a cockpit replica and radio in a fake callsign.

adventure.title: Ihwa Mural Village & Naksan Park Street Art Wander
adventure.description: Wander steep hillside stairways painted floor to ceiling with murals, fish, and giant sunflowers.
adventure.bonus: Find the fish-stair mural and photobomb a stranger's photo there, politely.

adventure.title: Ttukseom Hangang Park Kayaking
adventure.description: Paddle a kayak across the Han River's calm current with the city skyline rising on both banks.
adventure.bonus: Paddle close enough to touch a bridge pillar, then paddle straight back out.

adventure.title: Bukhansan Insubong Guided Rock Climbing
adventure.description: Rope up with a certified guide and climb exposed granite faces on Bukhansan's most technical peak.
adventure.bonus: Clip into the final anchor at the top and look straight down before you look up.

adventure.title: Seoul Sky Observatory, Lotte World Tower
adventure.description: Ride the world's fastest double-deck elevator to the 118th floor and stand on a glass floor 500 meters above Seoul.
adventure.bonus: Stand on the glass floor deck and count to ten out loud without stepping back.

adventure.title: Everland Theme Park Day Trip
adventure.description: Race between five themed zones and the wooden T Express coaster before Everland's gates close for the night.
adventure.bonus: Ride the T Express twice back-to-back before you let yourself eat lunch.

adventure.title: Screen Golf at Golfzon Park, Hongdae
adventure.description: Tee off on a hyperrealistic simulated fairway inside a private bay, snacks and drinks ordered right to your screen.
adventure.bonus: Book a virtual round on a course you'll never actually play in real life.

adventure.title: Seoul Plaza Ice Skating Rink
adventure.description: Lace up skates and loop the outdoor rink in front of City Hall as the plaza glows under winter lights.
adventure.bonus: Skate one full lap without holding the wall.

adventure.title: COEX Aquarium
adventure.description: Walk through an underwater tunnel while sharks and rays glide overhead in the middle of Gangnam.
adventure.bonus: Find the shark tunnel and stand under it for one full minute.

adventure.title: Kukkiwon Taekwondo Experience Class
adventure.description: Suit up in a real dobok and throw your first taekwondo kicks at the sport's official world headquarters.
adventure.bonus: Break a wooden board on your first real try and keep the pieces.

adventure.title: KBO Baseball Game at Jamsil Baseball Stadium
adventure.description: Join thousands of fans in synchronized chants and cheer squads at a live KBO baseball game.
adventure.bonus: Learn one team cheer chant from the fans next to you and yell it on cue.

adventure.title: Bukhansan Baegundae Peak Hike
adventure.description: Grip a support rope up the final granite scramble to Bukhansan's 836-meter summit for a 360-degree view of Seoul.
adventure.bonus: Grab the summit rope at Baegundae Peak and yell your trail name into the wind.

adventure.title: Bukhansanseong Fortress Circuit Hike
adventure.description: Scramble along a 17th-century mountain fortress wall with sweeping views of Seoul spread out below.
adventure.bonus: Touch the fortress wall at the highest gate you reach and name it after yourself.

adventure.title: Common Ground Container Mall, Konkuk
adventure.description: Browse 200 stacked shipping containers turned into shops, food stalls, and a live event stage.
adventure.bonus: Buy one thing from a container you'd never normally shop in.

adventure.title: Han River Cycling: Yeouido to Banpo Bridge
adventure.description: Pedal a rented bike along the river from Yeouido's cherry-lined path to Banpo Bridge's fountain show.
adventure.bonus: Ride under three different bridges without stopping to check your phone once.

social.title: Noraebang Night at Luxury Su Noraebang, Hongdae
social.description: Grab a glowing glass-walled private room and belt out K-pop hits until your throat gives out.
social.bonus: Sing one song entirely in Korean, lyrics on screen, no English subtitle cheating.

social.title: Escape Room Challenge at Seoul Escape Room, Hongdae
social.description: Race the clock cracking codes and hidden compartments before your hour locked in runs out.
social.bonus: Solve the final puzzle with under two minutes left on the clock.

social.title: K-pop Dance Class — 1MILLION Dance Studio ViBE Program
social.description: Learn a full idol-level choreography routine inside the studio behind the world's biggest K-pop dance channel.
social.bonus: Film your final run-through and send it to the group chat, no re-takes allowed.

social.title: Ikseon-dong Makgeolli Bar Hopping
social.description: Hop between hanok bars pouring flavored makgeolli in a neighborhood that used to be all quiet residential lanes.
social.bonus: Order a makgeolli you've never heard of and rate it out of 10 with the group.

social.title: Banpo Dokkaebi Night Market
social.description: Graze fusion food truck dishes and browse handmade goods under string lights along the riverbank.
social.bonus: Try a fusion food truck dish you can't find back home.

social.title: Super Board Game Cafe, Hongdae
social.description: Pick from hundreds of board games stacked floor to ceiling and out-strategize your friends over coffee.
social.bonus: Pick the game with the worst rulebook in the stack and figure it out as you go.

social.title: DDP LED Rose Garden Night Stroll
social.description: Wander thousands of glowing LED roses set against Zaha Hadid's spaceship-curved design plaza.
social.bonus: Find the best angle of the LED roses against DDP's curved facade for one photo.

social.title: Hongdae Playground Bar & Club Hop
social.description: Follow the crowd from street performers at Hongdae Playground straight into basement clubs pumping until dawn.
social.bonus: Let a total stranger's playlist pick your next bar.

social.title: Hanbok Rental & Gyeongbokgung Palace Photo Walk
social.description: Slip into a rented hanbok and glide past Gyeongbokgung's palace guards for free, photo-ready entry.
social.bonus: Get free-entry treatment for wearing hanbok and strike a royal pose at the throne hall.

social.title: K-Star Road GangnamDol Photo Walk
social.description: Pose next to life-sized K-pop idol bear statues lining a mile of Gangnam's trendiest street.
social.bonus: Pose with your bias group's GangnamDol statue and strike their signature move.

social.title: E-Land Dinner & Fireworks Night Cruise, Yeouido
social.description: Sail the Han River on a buffet dinner cruise as fireworks burst over Yeouido's skyline.
social.bonus: Make it to the top deck before the fireworks start and hold your spot.

social.title: Itaewon World Food Street Bar Crawl
social.description: Bar-hop down a strip stacked with Nigerian, Turkish, Mexican, and Nepali spots between rounds of drinks.
social.bonus: Order a dish from a country you've never actually visited.

foodie.title: Myeongdong Night Street Food Alley
foodie.description: Zigzag down a neon-lit alley grabbing skewers, cheese corn dogs, and honey bread off sizzling street carts.
foodie.bonus: Try three street foods you can't pronounce before turning back.

foodie.title: Temple Cuisine Tasting at Balwoo Gongyang
foodie.description: Savor a Michelin-starred, entirely plant-based tasting menu built on centuries-old Buddhist monastery recipes.
foodie.bonus: Eat the entire course without once asking where the garlic and onion went.

foodie.title: Kimchi-Making Class at O'ngo Food Communications
foodie.description: Massage gochugaru paste into cabbage leaves under a chef's guidance and take your own jar of kimchi home.
foodie.bonus: Name your kimchi batch and text a photo of it to your mom.

foodie.title: Namdaemun Market Day Shopping & Street Food
foodie.description: Haggle through Korea's oldest traditional market for knife-cut noodles and stalls selling everything under one roof.
foodie.bonus: Buy something from the oldest-looking stall you can find and ask the vendor its story.

foodie.title: Tosokchon Samgyetang Ginseng Chicken Soup
foodie.description: Crack into a whole ginseng chicken stuffed with rice and jujube at the restaurant that made samgyetang famous.
foodie.bonus: Finish the whole ginseng chicken, then order the leftover rice porridge on the house.

foodie.title: Chimaek Night at Kkanbu Chicken, Hongdae
foodie.description: Crack open ice-cold beer next to a mountain of double-fried Korean chicken, Hongdae-style.
foodie.bonus: Clink a mug of beer with a table of strangers and wish them "chukbae."

foodie.title: K-BBQ Dinner at Mapo Jeong Daepo
foodie.description: Grill smoky galmaegisal over charcoal at a no-frills local favorite Anthony Bourdain once raved about.
foodie.bonus: Wrap a bite of galmaegisal in lettuce with five toppings and eat it in one bite.

foodie.title: Gwangjang Market Street Food Crawl
foodie.description: Elbow up to a market stall counter for sizzling mung bean pancakes and hand-rolled mayak gimbap.
foodie.bonus: Order mayak gimbap and eat it in under 90 seconds, market-vendor style.

foodie.title: Noryangjin Fisheries Market Seafood Feast
foodie.description: Pick a live octopus or fresh sea bream off the ice and have it sliced and grilled minutes later.
foodie.bonus: Haggle for your own live seafood pick and watch it get sliced tableside.

foodie.title: Ikseon-dong Hanok Alley Food & Coffee Crawl
foodie.description: Duck between century-old hanok roofs hunting down hidden cafes serving cotton candy lattes and modern desserts.
foodie.bonus: Find a cafe hidden inside a 100-year-old hanok and order the weirdest drink on the menu.

foodie.title: Traditional Tea Ceremony at Cha Masineun Tteul, Insadong
foodie.description: Sip wild mountain tea and nibble rice cakes in a hanok courtyard tucked behind Insadong's main street.
foodie.bonus: Order the tea you can't translate and guess the flavor before the menu tells you.

foodie.title: Hansik Cooking Class at the Institute of Traditional Korean Food
foodie.description: Plate a royal court-style Korean meal under the guidance of chefs from a rice-cake museum's own kitchen.
foodie.bonus: Plate your dish like it's headed to a royal banquet and photograph it before eating.
